save.text: Sam absent; Scanlan to be piloted by Keyleth and Percy. Pike still in New York. Patrick Rothfuss (Kerrek) joining via Skype.
Lootcrate sponsorship back; January theme Origins; order cutoff 9PM tonight; URL lootcrate.com/criticalrole; promo code 'criticalrole' for 10% off first month.
Blue Microphones provided new equipment; Matt uses Blue mics; site bluemic.com.
New store item: socks with 'How do you want to do this?' and logo; potential future Sox Machina; dice restock targeted this or next month; pins and bracelets limited stock back.
Convention: Anime Milwaukee Feb 17-19; attending: Matt, Marisha, Travis, Laura; CR panel, signings, other panels.
Patrick Rothfuss may try to meet at Milwaukee; dinner suggested.

Recap: Raishan fled Emon with Thordak’s corpse and two eggs; scrying found her on a southern Lucidian Ocean island (Thordak’s former lair, once Opash’s). Kerrek joined to aid search; party long-rested; Scanlan, Percy, Pike leveled.
Item IDs: Boots returned to Vax (Liam); Grog took Dragonkilling sword to consider; Dwarven Thrower warhammer found but requires dwarf attunement (so unusable by Grog).
Pike spell choice discussed: cleric doesn’t need to pre-pick like ranger; joke about Power Word Kill Green Dragon; final choice TBD.

Dwarven Thrower can be attuned if Belt of Dwarvenkind is attuned; losing belt drops hammer attunement. Grog currently opting to attune Dwarven Thrower (considering vs Blood Axe); damage die d8 (vs d12), thrown 20/60; Reckless cancels disadvantage at >20 ft.

Boots: Vax’s boots returned; Boots of Elvenkind offered to Pike (no attunement per Matt). Would replace Pike’s Sprinter’s Boots if worn; Sprinter’s may require attunement (Matt to double-check) and swapping mid-mission is slow.
Attunements and items: Vax attuned Deathwalker’s Ward to necrotic. Grog has Dancing Sword (needs attunement). Kerrek has two attuned items and can attune Dancing Sword if needed.

Dancing Sword revealed cursed; upon Grog handling, curse triggered, sword turned inert. Grog suffers permanent -2 to all saving throws; Matt corrected prior session’s mistake per Deck of Many Things card.
Curse removal: Matt says penalty is permanent until a god removes it; Greater Restoration may not suffice, though Pike considers trying it.
Keyleth offered Ring of Protection +2 to offset saves/AC; requires attunement. Grog declined; also full on attunements likely.
Pike cast Greater Restoration (5th) on Grog; headache/curse unchanged. Divine magic couldn’t fix it.
Kerrek received Cloak of Displacement (loan) and Vax’s Ring of Invisibility (loan); ring makes wearer invisible until removed, attack/spell, or bonus action to end.
Pike cast Heroes’ Feast (6th) using a diamond from hoard; party (incl. Trinket, Kerr, Allura, Kima) gains immune to poison/fear, +15 max HP, and adv. on Wisdom saves.
Matt clarified scrying at a location creates a visible sensor to creatures with see invisibility; risk of tipping off target.
Party plans: Use Transport via Plants (Keyleth) to Opash’s island instead of Allura’s Teleport (7th) to conserve higher slot.
Gate Stone left in Whitestone under Cassandra’s care; Kima took it to deliver.
Vex gives Kima Boots of Elvenkind; Kima accepts and wears them despite dislike of style.
Party uses Transport via Plants via Sun Tree to Island of Viscan; Vex cast Pass without Trace before stepping through.
Blight on island’s trees radiates from Opash’s mountain; appears as radial corruption, not identified as fire by Grog’s failed check.
Dead/petrified trees on Opash’s island are centuries old; scarring not recent; Keyleth confirmed, Matt stated timeline.
Pass without Trace active during island traversal; group rolled high stealth; Kima’s Boots negated her disadvantage.
Allura’s research: Indigenous people once lived/traded here; vanished after Opash settled; island considered cursed; scavengers rarely return.
Clarified: Raishan performed rituals embedding the gem in Thordak’s chest on the Plane of Fire; gem was created by Allura, Kima, Drake. Matt cautioned uncertain reliability of Raishan’s accounts.

Approaching mountain, party found multiple oval unstable ground patches (10–15 ft) amid increasingly withered trees; identified as ‘hollow earth’—magically eroded, sinkhole-prone ground. Avoid stepping on them.
Test: Grog threw a rock onto a patch; after a moment it dropped through, leaving a void imprint—confirms instability without immediate surface collapse.
Closer to mountain, trees show no blast pattern; they rapidly died in place; deadness increases nearer mountain.
Found mountain entrance blocked by 20–30 ft boulder; surface pierced by clustered claw holes matching a very large dragon; boulder has been placed/removed many times over years.
Debate on entry: avoid moving full boulder; plan to Stone Shape at seam to create passage while keeping boulder as barrier; suggestion to scry inside first.
Decision: Party proceeds in through boulder entrance now; minimal prep; plan to stealth; prior Stone Shape/scry debate effectively dropped.
Vex uses Primeval Awareness: detects three dragon life forces within 1 mile, below the mountain; confirms Raishan + two eggs likely alive.
Patrick’s character used Divine Sense: no celestial/fiend/undead within 60 ft near the boulder.
Grog trades Parapet of Wound Closure to Vex in exchange for the Deck of Many Things; Vex makes Grog promise not to draw or look; Grog agrees and takes the deck in a pouch.
Trade completed: Vex gives Grog the Deck of Many Things; Grog gives Vex the Periapt of Wound Closure; Grog promises not to look while Vex is present.
Stone Shape used on boulder/entrance makes only a small 5-ft-deep opening; wall much thicker; slight hole allows arm-through view into tunnel.
Oracle Arrow fired through hole: 100 ft tunnel then curves left, descends; pitch-black, heavy undisturbed dust, no visible tracks or movement.
Party considers entry options: second Stone Shape could carve pullable chunk; concern about noise if Grog uses Siege Gauntlets; lever plan via small hole to shift boulder and slip in, then reseat.
Current small arm-width hole from Stone Shape exists; team debates using it for lever with magical weapon; no external switch found; dragon-sized fingerholds confirm boulder manually placed.
Boulder shows big dragon fingerholds; confirms repeated manual placement; no switches present around entrance per investigation (17).
Lever plan executed: Pike assists Grog using sword as lever; Grog STR 23 shifts boulder ~1.5 ft; party adds strength to widen gap.
Two Immovable Rods wedged into dragon finger-holes to hold boulder; door left wedged shut for exit plan; boulder later appears stationary inside.
Inside tunnel: 15-ft wide, ~12-ft tall; dust, smell of rot/stagnant water; carved passage with no airflow; scattered charred bone shards on floor.
Bone shards: Marisha/Nature 28—charring years old or more; dust layer shows untouched for a while. Confirms Thordak laired here long ago.
Group stealth checks called; results: Vex 30, Vax 35, Percy 34, Keyleth 30, Grog 30, Pike 25, Scanlan 18, Kerrek 29.
Pike casts Death Ward (4th) on Vex; lasts 8 hours; Liam requested for Vex; Matt confirms effect.
Light rules: Vax’s flaming dagger sheds candle-like light; with dagger out he gets 60 ft as bright via Darkvision feature; without it he can only see ~15 ft dimly. Matt clarified mechanics.
Corridor alcoves: shelves every ~20 ft with votive items—melted candles, skull with candles, small books and a wooden box (untrapped by Vax, left behind), and a mummified raccoon-like creature.
Party chooses darkness for stealth: initial dagger light lit then put out on Grog’s request; pairs link arms—Keyleth guides Percy; Kerrek cuddles up with Grog.
Kerrek uses Divine Sense; detects an undead presence to his left in the wall area; not extremely powerful; later corrected to give type/location unless behind total cover.
Left-wall shelf: two melted candles and a human skull (dusty, slightly singed). Grog approaches, retrieves skull, and hands it to Kerrek.
Kerrek suspects skull may be a watcher/trigger; party considers it a security camera. Kerrek requests the skull; Grog complies.
Divine Sense reconfirmed: skull Kerrek held is the undead source; inert when handled.
Party decides not to destroy skull; Kerrek sacks it and sets it back on shelf facing wall (burlap).

New chamber: hexagonal room ends at large iron door; central dark green marble pillar with bolted rough iron bowl atop a chest-high dais; side shelf holds large leather-bound tome and a cold iron brazier with dried tinder.

Room layout clarified: party entered chamber; opposite large iron door blocks progress; between: raised dais with central dark green marble pillar and bolted iron bowl; right wall shelf with large leather tome and a cold iron brazier with dried tinder. No ceiling slots or visible mechanisms; walls are old masonry with some cave-ins; door seams smooth, no chains/pulleys.
Bowl residue identified: Vex scrapes dried dark burgundy powder; iron taste—interpreted as old blood. Suggestion: bleeding into bowl may open door (speculative).
Tome details: large, unlabeled leather tome on shelf; Grog inspects—thick leather, possibly tanned hide or flesh; very old.
Book reacts: any attempt to focus makes text shrink/blur to unreadable; brighter light makes pages nearly blank (tiny dots).
Brazier has a lot of dried tinder; no ceiling holes confirmed again. Party considering blood-in-bowl; have vials incl. dragon blood in Bag of Holding.
Plan shift: Percival suggests extinguish all lights; someone with low-light/darkvision to read tome. Hammer light extinguished to try this.
Attempt failed: With hammer-light off text was slightly more legible but still blurred to Vex and others; none could read it. Considered night vision readers.
Brazier lit by Keyleth exploded violently; Percival, Allura, Vex, Vax saved; Kerrek failed. Damage: Kerrek/Keyleth 32 fire; others 16; Vax evaded. Brazier ruined.
Book destroyed in explosion; Allura infers book’s purpose was a trap with flammable liquids (not black powder).
Basilisk-blood door: Vex’s blood into bowl triggered door; basilisk blood sizzled to edges; metallic door lifted. Vex took 1 damage from blood loss.
Flaming skulls encountered: four flame-wreathed floating skulls approached from both hallway directions; cackling; one may have been the bagged skull source.
Pike cast Holy Aura on party: 30-ft radius; allies get adv on saves; enemies have disadv on attacks; fiends/undead melee must Con save or be blinded; radiant rune circle formed.
Initiative: Pike rolled 9; Kerrek rolled 1 (anchor-man).
Scanlan cast Invisibility (2nd level) and backed to northern wall; held no action beyond movement.
Vax flew 10 ft up to opposite wall; hit a flaming skull twice (Whisper + venom dagger) for 29 total (incl. 19 with Whisper).

Holy Aura adv on saves applied to party; during four flame skull Fireballs, DC 13 Dex. Saves: Percy all; Keyleth all; Vax all (Evasion=0); Vex all; Kerrek all; Grog 2 fail/2 save; Pike 2 fail/2 save; Scanlan exempt (Invisibility, not targeted).

Fireball damage totals ruled: save all = 56 fire; Grog (2 fails) = 88; Pike (2 fails, fire resist) = 44; Vex = 56; Percy = 56; Kerrek = 56; Vax = 0 (Evasion). Trinket failed 3, was in necklace already after; Vex at 57 HP; Keyleth at 50 HP.
Flame skulls targeted cluster, not knowing Scanlan’s location; four simultaneous Fireballs from four skulls.
Kerrek’s Aura of Protection (+3 saves) applies to nearby allies. Retroactive: Pike gained +3; Grog’s two 10s became 13s so he saved all four Fireballs (total 56). Trinket still failed three.
Percy (Animus) killed two flame skulls this turn: first with 27+2 psychic; second with 20+4 psychic after a prior hit of 22+6 psychic. Regained grit on each kill; moved and perched on wall.
